result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer breaks the export. The `reports` module compiles. I did not run any tests or try a renamed config end to end.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in the zip-writing block. It replaces the five hardcoded `aspect_*.txt` literals with a loop over the main, test, generated, build and deployment, and other aspects. For each one it calls `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same method that names the loose text files, to read the file and name the zip entry.

With the default config the entries and their order are unchanged. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The `git-history.zip` step comes after the file lookup, so it is written again too when a `git-history.txt` exists.
